title: Mods installer: offer each mod like the status line, installed at user scope on the person's yes
summary: orion now carries each mod in every project as one archive and installs it on a computer only on the person's word (orion.sh mod install|skip|remove), offering newer versions at session start. The owner's own install of Control Tower is left for after the merge, since the owner retired owner-merges.
friction: Two review rounds were spent on design gaps the story did not foresee: an update is run by the project's older orion.sh, so new copy steps need the redo-once guard; and copying a mod's TypeScript sources into a project lets the project's own test and lint tools collect them. A story that adds files to the project copy should name both up front.
lessons_learned: Anything new orion copies into a project must be invisible to the project's own tools (test runners, linters, TypeScript): store it as an archive or in a form with no source extensions.

deferred.what: The real claude plugin install/uninstall/marketplace commands were only exercised against a stub; the --marketplace option needs a recent Claude Code, so an install on an older Claude Code may fail.
deferred.why: Agents may not install into the owner's real ~/.claude; the owner's first real install is the proof.
